== Course of events ==

Following her wandering through Wonderland—during which she journeyed with the Gryphon to find the Mock Turtle and encountered the Duchess upon the croquet ground—Alice returns to the croquet game. There, the Queen presides over the assembled players in her terrible authority. In this moment, the Queen exercises her sovereign will: she sentences numerous players to execution. The event stands as a stark crystallization of Wonderland's peculiar justice, where the Queen's pronouncements fall with swift and absolute finality upon those gathered at her croquet game, each sentence delivered as surely as the rules of the game itself demand.
